summary: Board voted 7-1-1 to direct staff to draft a resolution pausing consideration of legislative data center and substation applications for up to 12 months from the date the application was submitted to the planning commission.

source.citation: DC News Now, NBC4, FOX 5 DC and WJLA, September 15-16 2026

notes: Supervisor Kristen Umstattd opposed; Supervisor Caleb Kershner abstained. Board Chair Phyllis Randall described the measure as not a ban or moratorium but time to craft new laws. Projects already in the pipeline unaffected. Final vote expected October 13, 2026; the separate grandfather amendment report is scheduled for October 6. Substations are named expressly, which no other jurisdiction in this corpus does.
confidence_note: What passed is a direction to draft a resolution. No resolution text exists. The 12-month clock running from application submission rather than from adoption is an unusual construction and has not been read in any document.
